title: llms.txt must begin with an H1 title
rationale: conformance_testable is false: llmstxt.org frames its structure as a convention for LLM-friendly indexing, not a conformance-tested format, even though the H1 is its one genuinely required element -- see the structure-arm header comment in audits/checks/b2-llms.mjs (it was validate-llms-txt.mjs's until atlas decision 0119 D2 retired that file). Verified against the pinned source (AnswerDotAI/llms-txt @c7178b9, nbs/index.qmd) on 2026-07-30: the quote is exact (Format list item 2; source line 42 carries no trailing period, and a stray one was removed in this review pass). (Was previously disclosed as recalled-not-verified; the disclosure is now the checkable verified_against_source field.) RE-PINNED 2026-10-07 to v2 (AnswerDotAI/llms-txt @6e55a65, nbs/index.qmd) after a full re-read: the Format list is byte-identical to v1 (v1 lines 40-46 equal v2 lines 49-55), so the quote is unchanged and now sits at source line 51. v2 rewrote only the surrounding prose (path scope, the "Optional" section, .md naming, link relations, the RFC 8615 rationale), none of which this rule reads.
